$comment: Public capability contract for CC Pocket. The website, both READMEs and scripts/check-public-content.py all answer to this file. Serving the static site needs no build step — the HTML restates these facts inline and the checker proves the two agree.

note.en: This is the public v1.8.0 capability baseline. Every capability claim below was audited against commit 6162816a on main.
note.zh: 这是 v1.8.0 的公开能力基线。下面的每条能力都已对照 main 分支的 6162816a 提交核验。

jobs.resultEn: See what the agent is doing without walking back to the desk.
jobs.resultZh: 人不在电脑前，也知道 agent 干到哪一步了。

jobs.resultEn: Unblock a stopped agent from wherever you are — or refuse it.
jobs.resultZh: agent 卡住了，随手放行或者拒掉。

jobs.resultEn: Pick the same session back up instead of starting over.
jobs.resultZh: 接着原来那个会话往下走，不用重开。

jobs.resultEn: Read what actually changed before you trust the result.
jobs.resultZh: 结果值不值得信，先看改了什么。

en: No enforceable interactive approval — `opencode run` has no approval protocol, so sessions run at Full access.
No Changed files or line diff.
zh: 没有可执法的交互审批——`opencode run` 本身没有审批协议，会话恒为 Full access。
没有改动文件列表和行级 diff。

en: No Changed files or line diff.
zh: 没有改动文件列表和行级 diff。

en: No Changed files or line diff.
zh: 没有改动文件列表和行级 diff。

coreSession.noteEn: Discover, replay, create, resume, send and receive text, live streaming
coreSession.noteZh: 发现、回放、新建、恢复、收发文本、实时流式

approvalMode.noteEn: Launch sandbox default only; remote approvals are not bridged and fail closed
approvalMode.noteZh: 仅启动时的 sandbox 默认值；远程审批未桥接，失败即拒

en: No remote approval bridge — a request that needs one fails closed.
No Changed files or line diff.
zh: 远程审批没有桥接——需要审批的请求直接失败即拒。
没有改动文件列表和行级 diff。

surfaces.descEn: Where you watch, approve, continue and inspect.
surfaces.descZh: 查看、授权、继续、检查都在这里。

surfaces.descEn: The same client as a two-pane console — one computer driving another.
surfaces.descZh: 同一个客户端的两栏控制台——用一台电脑操另一台。

surfaces.descEn: Runs on the computer that owns your code and drives the agent CLI. A different package from the desktop app.
surfaces.descZh: 跑在放着你代码的那台电脑上，驱动 agent CLI。和桌面 App 是两个不同的安装包。

surfaces.descEn: Pairs your devices and forwards ciphertext. Hosted for you, or run your own.
surfaces.descZh: 帮设备配对、转发密文。默认用托管的，也可以自建。

linux.en: No official Linux desktop package — build from source.
linux.zh: 没有正式的 Linux 桌面安装包，只能从源码构建。

relay.en: A hosted zero-knowledge relay is the default; self-hosting is supported.
relay.zh: 默认走托管的零知识中继，也支持自托管。

highlights.en: A sixth agent backend: DeepSeek — discovery, replay, new sessions, resume, text and live streaming, within the limits above.
highlights.zh: 第六个 agent 后端 DeepSeek：会话发现、回放、新建、恢复、收发文本、实时流式，边界见上表。

highlights.en: Filter projects, sessions and usage by agent.
highlights.zh: 项目、会话、用量都能按 agent 筛。

highlights.en: Kimi Code and ZCode report usage.
highlights.zh: Kimi Code 和 ZCode 有用量数据了。

highlights.en: Start a new task straight from the phone or the desktop app.
highlights.zh: 手机和桌面 App 都能直接起一个新任务。

highlights.en: Images in your own prompts stay visible in session replay.
highlights.zh: 自己发的提示词里的图片，回放时还在。

highlights.en: A managed daemon keeps itself up to date by default, and you can opt out.
highlights.zh: 托管安装的 daemon 默认自己升级，也可以关掉。

highlights.en: The desktop app states it plainly when an update check fails instead of looking up to date.
highlights.zh: 桌面 App 检查更新失败时会明说，不再装作已是最新。

media.statementEn: Real product UI with scripted demo data.
media.statementZh: 真实产品界面，演示数据由脚本生成。
